title: Information Transparency, Choice Confidence, and Customer Retention: Field and Laboratory Evidence from Markets for Credence Goods
eligible_reason: Observational churn analysis with propensity-score matching plus a two-period DiD around a single 53-day delisting of the insurer from comparison platforms (14 July to 5 September 2012). One event, t in {0,1}, customer and period fixed effects, with controls. A randomized online experiment supplements the field evidence. No staggered adoption.
design_notes: Eq. (2): Churn_it = a + rho*Comparison_it + X_it'beta + delta_i + gamma_t + e_it, t=1 during the disruption, t=0 before. Figure 4 reports baseline (-4.6 pp), matching (-6.2 pp) and DiD (-11.8 pp) estimates.
estimators_reported: two-period DiD with customer and period FE
screener_notes: Ineligible: two-period single-event DiD. Proprietary European insurer data.
